root_cause: NoxPackHost.advertise ran available() for every session.allowed route before checking risk/private_approved. A denied sensitive route or never-advertised dangerous route could invoke arbitrary native readiness work despite returned HOLD.
fix: Gate available() by allowed + private scope and deny dangerous advertisement probes; execute() still enforces real consent/ACL and route owner identity.
